One `src-tauri/src/tests/<module>.rs` per tested module, declared at the end of the module with `#[cfg(test)] #[path = …] mod tests;`. ## similar.rs — 8 test(s), tests `src-tauri/src/similar.rs`

Tests of the similar-image search: grouping, rotations, bursts, flat pictures, cache and cancellation. Synthetic files in a temporary folder only.

- `resized_copies_are_grouped_and_other_pictures_are_not`
- `rotated_copies_need_the_rotation_option`
- `flat_pictures_are_never_grouped`
- `bursts_are_left_out_but_copies_with_the_same_time_are_kept`
- `a_selection_is_compared_with_the_library_only_when_asked`
- `fingerprints_are_cached_and_unsupported_formats_counted`
- `a_loose_threshold_chains_everything_into_one_group_or_drops_it`
- `cancelled_search_returns_no_group`

## thumbnails.rs — 5 test(s), tests `src-tauri/src/thumbnails.rs`

Tests de non-régression de l'orientation et de l'EXIF des RAW (thumbnails.rs). Aucun vrai RAW : un CR3 minimal (boîtes CMT1 / CMT2) et des JPEG synthétiques sont fabriqués à la main.

- `cr3_reads_orientation_from_cmt1_and_exif_from_cmt2`
- `preview_orientation_comes_from_raw_when_preview_has_no_tag`
- `preview_own_orientation_tag_is_kept`
- `dng_without_jpeg_uses_uncompressed_rgb_thumbnail`
- `thumbnail_quality_levels_write_valid_jpegs`

## update_check.rs — 12 test(s), tests `src-tauri/src/update_check.rs`

Tests de la vérification des mises à jour (update_check.rs) : lecture des versions et choix de la release dans une réponse GitHub. Aucun accès au réseau.

- `versions_are_parsed_from_tags_and_package_versions`
- `numbers_are_compared_as_numbers_not_as_text`
- `stable_installation_ignores_prereleases_drafts_and_non_app_releases`
- `up_to_date_installation_gets_no_update`
- `prereleases_are_offered_on_request`
- `beta_installation_gets_prereleases_without_asking`
- `beta_suffix_does_not_make_the_same_release_an_update`
- `no_eligible_release_means_no_update_and_bad_json_is_an_error`
- `windows_takes_the_english_msi_never_the_setup_exe_and_linux_takes_the_deb`
- `unsafe_or_unverifiable_assets_are_refused`
- `download_is_kept_only_when_size_and_sha256_match`
- `cancelled_download_leaves_nothing`
